question: Can you provide a breakdown of how many times each product was viewed, how many times they were added to the shopping cart, and how many times they were left in the cart without being purchased? Also, give me the count of actual purchases for each product. Ensure that products with a page id in (1, 2, 12, 13) are filtered out.
sql:
WITH purchase_events AS (
    SELECT visit_id, cookie_id, page_id, event_type, sequence_number
    FROM shopping_cart_events 
    WHERE event_type = 3
),
add_to_cart_with_product AS (
    SELECT 
        sc.visit_id,
        sc.cookie_id,
        sc.page_id,
        sc.event_type,
        sc.sequence_number,
        ph.product_id
    FROM shopping_cart_events sc
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy ph ON sc.page_id = ph.page_id
    WHERE ph.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
    AND sc.event_type = 2
),
last_cart_before_purchase AS (
    SELECT 
        pe.visit_id,
        MAX(atcp.sequence_number) as max_cart_seq
    FROM purchase_events pe
    JOIN add_to_cart_with_product atcp ON pe.visit_id = atcp.visit_id AND atcp.sequence_number < pe.sequence_number
    GROUP BY pe.visit_id
),
purchased_products AS (
    SELECT 
        pe.visit_id,
        atcp.product_id
    FROM purchase_events pe
    JOIN add_to_cart_with_product atcp ON pe.visit_id = atcp.visit_id AND atcp.sequence_number < pe.sequence_number
    JOIN last_cart_before_purchase lbp ON pe.visit_id = lbp.visit_id
    AND atcp.sequence_number = lbp.max_cart_seq
),
page_views AS (
    SELECT 
        ph.product_id,
        COUNT(*) as page_views
    FROM shopping_cart_events sc
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy ph ON sc.page_id = ph.page_id
    WHERE ph.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
    AND sc.event_type = 1
    GROUP BY ph.product_id
),
add_to_cart AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        COUNT(*) as add_to_cart
    FROM add_to_cart_with_product
    GROUP BY product_id
),
purchases AS (
    SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) as purchases
    FROM purchased_products
    GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT 
    pv.product_id,
    pv.page_views,
    atc.add_to_cart,
    pp.purchases,
    atc.add_to_cart - pp.purchases as left_in_cart
FROM page_views pv
JOIN add_to_cart atc ON pv.product_id = atc.product_id
JOIN purchases pp ON pv.product_id = pp.product_id
ORDER BY pv.product_id
